answer_1.quote: this paper presents an effective knowledge-based neural conversation model that enhances the incorporation between knowledge selection and generation to produce more informative and meaningful responses.

answer_2.quote: We adopt an automatic evaluation with several common metrics proposed by [reference] and use their available automatic evaluation tool to calculate the experimental results... Metrics include Bleu1/2/3, F1, DISTINCT1/2 automatically measure the fluency, coherence, relevance, diversity, etc.

answer_4.quote: Besides, we provide 3 annotators to evaluate the results on a human level. The annotators evaluate the quality of dialog response generated on fluency, informativeness, and coherence.
answer_4.guideline: The score ranges from 0 to 2 to reflect the fluency, informativeness, and coherence of results from bad to good.
